notes: Renders as <button>, <a>, or dropdown wrapper depending on props. Label renders through Text atom (via contentButton). Decorative icon nested as a media atom node (Icon | LottieIcon) — Button mirrors the family pattern from Heading/Badge/List. Colour comes from the global .color--{name} mixin via brandColor / rainbowColor. Tiers are NOT supported on the Button itself (preset variant styling) — but the nested Icon/LottieIcon child CAN use colorTier freely. When variant=fill/glow/rainbow-glow and the icon shares Button's colour, Button strips the matching colour props from the child so the icon inherits currentColor and remains visible (icon-contrast-on-fill). Confetti is no longer a Button prop — wrap with the Confetti atom when you want a particle burst.

_rules.note: Button itself does NOT accept colorTier — variant styling (fill/outline/glass/glow/etc.) is preset and tier shifts would break those contracts. The nested media child (Icon/LottieIcon) CAN use colorTier freely — that's a child-atom concern, not a button-level one.

Heavy SVG effects (morph/draw/fillAnimation) are allowed on the Icon ONLY when the button is icon-only (no contentButton, shape='circle' or 'i-*'). The icon is the focal point in that case. Buttons with text labels treat the icon as supplementary chrome — heavy SVG would distract; only spin/bounce/micro.ts animations apply there.

_rules._condition: (variant === 'fill' || variant === 'glow' || variant === 'rainbow-glow') && media && ((media.brandColor && media.brandColor === brandColor) || (media.rainbowColor && media.rainbowColor === rainbowColor)) && (media.colorTier ?? 'base') === 'base'
_rules._action: Button strips the matching colour props from the child media spread so the child falls back to inheriting currentColor — Button.css computes this as an oklch lightness inversion of --_color, producing visible contrast against the filled background. Mirrors Shape's same-named rule. Phase 3 CSS implements the oklch contrast on .btn--fill / .btn--glow / .btn--rainbow-glow.
_rules.note: Runtime auto-strip — not a JSON validation rule. Phase 2 astro implements.
Button.media accepts only Icon or LottieIcon (decorative chrome). Already enforced by the media.component enum in the schema; this rule entry is documentation only.

_rules._action: Strip the effect prop, keep the variant. Console warns in DEV.
_rules.note: These specific combos conflict visually: outline+split (split's halves cover the outlined border), glow+colour-flow / glow+split / rainbow-glow+colour-flow (effects fight glow's gradient/halo). Author needs to choose either the variant OR the effect, not both.

content._description: What the button communicates and does

contentButton.description: Button label text. Pipeline content key. Forwarded to nested Text atom.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label. Useful for icon-only buttons or to add context beyond the visible label.

dropdownItems.description: Array of menu items shown when shape='dropdown'. Each item renders as <a> when href set, or <button> otherwise.

value.description: Optional data value (for forms or selection callbacks).

href.description: Makes the item a navigation link.

fontFamily.description: Optional font family override per item.

colour._description: Brand-scale colour. Use one of brandColor or rainbowColor, never both. Tiers not supported on Button — variant styling is preset.

brandColor.description: Brand-scale colour — sets brand tokens for any style variant. 'primary' is the default louder action colour; 'secondary' is the supporting accent; 'neutral' is the muted/utility colour.

rainbow._description: Rainbow palette colour (1-7 positional). Use one of brandColor or rainbowColor.

gradient._description: Gradient fill / glow on the button (matches Shape/Icon/Heading/Badge gradient spec). Used by variant='glow' and 'rainbow-glow' to source the glow gradient.

gradientBlend.description: Named blend from the gradient catalogue. Overrides single-colour gradient with a multi-colour blend.

gradientEmerge._description: Fade-in modifier — first 50% transparent, fades to solid.

gradientFade._description: Fade-out modifier — last 20% fades to transparent.

shape.description: Border radius shape. 'i-*' variants are icon-only square-ish shapes (matches the icon's natural bounds). Use 'circle' or any 'i-*' shape with a media Icon to make an icon-only button — those shapes also enable the heavy-svg-icon-only rule for the child Icon.

media._description: Decorative chrome — Icon or LottieIcon nested atom node. iconPosition is the Button-specific layout placement. Heavy SVG props (morphTo/draw/fillAnimation) are conditionally allowed — see _rules.heavy-svg-icon-only.

Nested atom node — Button hosts an Icon or LottieIcon. Always-available props: visual (weight, colour) + micro animations. Conditionally-available props (morph/draw/fill) only when the button is icon-only.

fallbackIcon._note: LottieIcon only — Phosphor slug used when motion is suppressed.

colorTier._note: Tier on the nested Icon/LottieIcon's colour. Implicit baseline 'base' — set explicitly only when you want a tint/mid/emphasis shift on the icon. Button-level colorTier is forbidden (see _rules.no-tiers-on-button), but the child icon can use tiers freely.

animation._note: Micro animation — same enum as Icon. Always available regardless of icon-only state.

animationRepeat._note: How many times to play. Implicit baseline is 'once'.

animationInterval._note: Gap between threeloop bursts. Implicit baseline is 'base'.

labelIcon._note: Required when semanticRole is ui-control or content-symbol.

morphTo._note: ICON-ONLY buttons (no contentButton, shape='circle' or 'i-*'). Forwarded to Icon.morphTo. Heavy SVG — gated by _rules.heavy-svg-icon-only.

fillAnimation._note: ICON-ONLY buttons. Heavy SVG — bloom fill from centre on trigger.

iconPosition.description: Icon position relative to label. Layout-only — applies regardless of which media atom is nested.

animation._description: Button-level motion — stripped in reduced/textonly renders. Icon-level animation lives on the media object (media.animation, media.animationTrigger, etc.).

effect.description: Hover/interaction effect on the button itself. `expand` shifts label left and reveals arrow on right. `confetti` fires a particle burst on click (motion-gate respects). Variant chrome stays intact.

gradientAnimated._description: Animate the gradient (rotation + sweep). Matches Heading/Badge/Shape gradient animation.

gradientAnimateDirection._note: Implicit baseline is 'cw' (no [data-grad-anim-dir] attribute emitted). Omit to use.

gradientAnimateSpeed._note: Implicit baseline is 'default' (no .gradient--speed-* class emitted). Omit to use.

gradientCycle._description: Colour cycle — cross-fades through tier tokens. Matches Heading/Badge/Shape.
